scenarios.given: A pytest suite and a fixed non-pytest command both have stable inputs and structured results.
scenarios.expected: Both are Verification Assets under one protocol; pytest is not authority.

scenarios.given: All admitted manifests exist in the repository.
scenarios.when: The Catalog is deleted and rebuilt.
scenarios.expected: Discovery and suite selection are restored without changing admission or behavior authority.

scenarios.given: A proposed formal asset lacks an oracle or scenario mapping.
scenarios.expected: Return specification_not_ready and do not admit or execute it.

scenarios.given: Assets target Module, Subsystem, Domain, and Global layers.
scenarios.expected: Selection preserves declared layer and requirement/scenario mappings.

scenarios.given: A Candidate has a draft asset awaiting review.
scenarios.expected: It automatically waits for Test Auditor admission; no human gate is implied.

scenarios.given: A Candidate sends a draft manifest directly to MVE.
scenarios.expected: Reject manifest_not_yet_admitted and execute nothing.

scenarios.given: An admitted active asset fails.
scenarios.expected: MVE reports the fixed result and cannot choose the easier selector.

scenarios.given: A required tool is unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Classify unavailable, never PASS.

scenarios.given: A new asset is authored and reviewed.
scenarios.expected: It follows draft, candidate, admission_validating, admitted, then active only when current.

scenarios.given: A required acceptance threshold has no confirmed source.
scenarios.expected: Emit specification_not_ready with automatic_relaxation false.

scenarios.given: An asset has nondeterministic repeated outcomes.
scenarios.expected: Mark suspect or quarantined and exclude it from completion.

scenarios.given: An asset is superseded by a new admitted version.
scenarios.expected: Supersession remains version lineage and retired asset cannot satisfy new completion.

scenarios.given: A candidate asset deletes an assertion.
scenarios.when: Mechanical Acceptance Guard compares it with protected acceptance.
scenarios.expected: Reject the weakening.

scenarios.given: Expected value is widened or a threshold is lowered.
scenarios.expected: Reject unless a separately confirmed semantic specification version authorizes it.

scenarios.given: Fixture is shrunk, a case removed, or skip/xfail/exclusion added.
scenarios.expected: Reject unapproved loss of required coverage.

scenarios.given: An asset author proposes a repair.
scenarios.when: Known-bad or mutation-style probe is evaluated.
scenarios.expected: Independent Auditor evidence must detect the seeded defect before admission.

scenarios.given: Only product source changes.
scenarios.expected: Mark minimal affected assets rerun_required rather than automatically stale.

scenarios.given: A fixture, helper, config, spec, contract, schema, profile, runner, or toolchain changes.
scenarios.expected: Create minimal affected validity re-evaluations.

scenarios.given: System Map returns affected architecture facts.
scenarios.expected: Record consumed facts; invocation alone is insufficient.

scenarios.given: Map coverage is stale or partial for a changed area.
scenarios.expected: Use bounded live-source fallback and retain specifications/source as authority.

scenarios.given: A small high-criticality behavior change and a large low-risk refactor.
scenarios.expected: Strength follows semantics and risk, not file count.

scenarios.given: An infrequently called stateless subsystem has no SLO or load requirement.
scenarios.expected: Load/soak is N/A with business reason, not imposed by layer.

scenarios.given: A specification or SLO requires throughput, volume, or long-lived stability.
scenarios.expected: The applicable stress asset is required.

scenarios.given: A fixed required suite exceeds preferred runtime budget.
scenarios.expected: Use ordering, shard, cache, parallelism, or placement only; never omit cases/oracles/thresholds.

scenarios.given: Current manifests require routine re-evaluation.
scenarios.expected: Execution consumes zero agent tokens and emits bounded deduplicated output.

scenarios.given: An active admitted asset passes repeatedly.
scenarios.expected: Retain rerunnable manifest/dependencies/environment declaration, not permanent raw logs or PASS receipts.

scenarios.given: A Work Package passes its fixed assets.
scenarios.expected: Work package, subsystem, domain, and release decisions remain distinct.

scenarios.given: This Phase 4 validator passes.
scenarios.expected: Report specification package integrity only; no subsystem/domain/release claim.
